ISO 9001: 2015, 14001: 2015, 45001:2018, CE, & GMP Certificates Minimum qualifying criteria for LED product manufacturer/supplier: 1. The bidder should submit the UP PWD AAA Certificate, BIS, and CRS-approved fitting certifications 2. The bidder should submit a 5-year warranty certificate for the LED street light on OEM letterhead. 3. It is compulsory to upload the factory license of the LED manufacturer along with the BID. 4. OEM must have an in-house NABL lab in its manufacturing plant; the certificate needs to be uploaded al ong with the bid documents. 5. OEM should have manufacturing plant in India with In-house NABL Lab, with in-house SMT, MCPCB machi nes, its Own driver manufacturing unit, C- and B-type photogoniometers, Automatic assembly lines, etc. 6. The OEM of the offered products must submit a declaration on letterhead stating that the OEM company has not been blacklisted or debarred by any government, semi-government, or PSU department for any re ason as of the date. 7. The OEM must have ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015, and 45001:2018 certifications. 8. EMD is compulsory for participation in this bid; a copy of the EMD must be attached with the documents. No exemption will be given, whether it is OEM or resellers. 9. The bidder must mandatorily submit authorization from the OEM for the offered products and an authori zation certificate for participating in the specific tender, both of which must be enclosed with the bid docu ments. 10. Bidder must submit all relevant documents like CRS, BIS, TDS, LM79, LM80, IP, TTC, Photobiology, NAB L In-house Lab in its manufacturing plant, Incorporation, and Trademark Certifications 11. OEMs must have their manufacturing plants in India (they must attach a valid document). 12. The LED street light and its driver must be of the same make. 13. All bidders are requested to upload all certificates, such as warranty, ESC matrix, and toll-free no., whi ch must have a valid date or be during the tender period. 14. An OEM authorization certificate is required, along with the employee's name, mobile number, designa tion, and email, to confirm any queries or bidder-related information. 15. Both the manufacturer and the supplied product must be registered in the UP PWD CAT AAA SOR; plea se submit the documentary evidence Technical Documents Required from Octagonal Pole Manufacturer : 1. Bidder must submit all relevant documents like BIS, TDS, type test report, UP PWD CAT AAA, and OEM a uthorization letter. 2. As per Govt. of India program (MEITY), The product manufacturer must have manufacturing facility in In dia to promote “MAKE IN INDIA." a) Factory License b) ISO 9001 c) ISO 14001 d) ISO 45001 .
